Variant 1 lets the equivalent allocation set the cap; variants 2 to 4 return the resulting surplus as rights so that club emissions match the proposal's, sharing it so as to minimise the largest shortfall against the proposal (2), in proportion to population times marginal utility (3), and by uniform scaling (4). The temperature row is the change from the proposal's own 2100 warming, which is 1.48\textdegree{}C for Equal Right and 1.66\textdegree{}C for Equal Right, 5\%/yr.
